name: equipping-stack-docs
description: Generates project-local documentation skills with version-pinned docs via Context7 - covers new stacks and legacy codebases
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for the equipping-stack-docs skill:

- When the skill says to confirm the technology list with your human partner, present the table and call Kimi Code's `AskUserQuestion` tool for the confirmation. Do not render the choices as plain assistant text unless `AskUserQuestion` is unavailable or the session is in auto permission mode.
- When the skill says to dispatch one subagent per technology with the embedded prompt template, use Kimi Code's `Agent` tool with `subagent_type: "coder"`, paste the fully filled template into `prompt`, and provide a short `description`. Do not pass `general-purpose` as `subagent_type`.
- Keep subagent dispatches parallel only when the skill says so; fall back to sequential dispatch on persistent rate limiting, as the skill instructs.
- When the skill refers to invoking another skill (e.g. a writing-plans skill), use Kimi Code's native `Skill` tool if that skill is installed; otherwise report the generated doc skills and return control.
- Use Kimi Code's `Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Bash`, `Grep`, and `Glob` tools by their actual exposed names for file checks and verification steps.

interface.shortDescription: Project-local doc skills pinned to the versions your project actually uses
interface.longDescription: Discovers your project's stack (from an approved design, manifests, or the code itself), then generates one documentation skill per technology with docs for the exact version in use - including legacy versions, with evidence-based delta annotations. Powered by the anonymous Context7 REST API.
